SitePartDef.label: abandoned Wraith laboratory
SitePartDef.description: A factionless ruin of breached living architecture, dead growth tissue and collapsed feeding equipment. It contains finite biological salvage but no functioning Wraith production shortcut.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: The coordinates lead to a breached, factionless Wraith laboratory. Dead biological machinery and finite salvage remain; a small remnant party may still be scavenging the site.
